name: WolfFlagsB
meaning: Wolf +0x718 gameplay flags

name: WOLF_FB_DEAD
meaning: dead/caught; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_DEAD) dead / restart pending

name: WOLF_FB_WON
meaning: level won (msg 0x401)

name: WOLF_FB_RUN
meaning: run flag (tap mechanic); (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_RUN) run flag (forced in states 0xcd/0xcf)

name: WOLF_FB_IN_WATER
meaning: inside water box in a non-water state

name: WOLF_FB_RECENT_CONTACT2
meaning: contact[2] within 0x400 ticks; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_RECENT_PICKUP) set on state entry when g_gameTime - +0x618 <= 0x400; blocks carry put-down

name: WOLF_FB_RECENT_OBJECT_CONTACT
meaning: touched an object within 0x400 ticks

name: WOLF_FB_FROZEN
meaning: input frozen by grabber (msg 0xE); (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_CONTROL_LOCKED) input frozen by +0x630

name: WOLF_FB_CINE_READY
meaning: msg 0x406/0x12; query 0x407; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_SCRIPT_DONE) set when scripted positioning ends; queried by msg 0x407

name: WOLF_FB_MOVED
meaning: non-zero displacement this frame

name: WOLF_FB_HELD_IN_USE
meaning: held object got msg 0x15 (use) and needs 0x16

name: WOLF_FB_SEESAW_CAM
meaning: set by MSG_SEESAW_TOUCH (0xb), cleared on landing; camera request bit (inferred)

name: WOLF_FB_LOOK_ALLOWED
meaning: msg 0x40A

name: WOLF_FB_IN_SLIDE_ZONE
meaning: zone 0x6d0c70; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_SLIDEBOX) inside slide box; doubles slope rate

name: WOLF_FB_FORCE_SLIDE
meaning: msg 0x27, per frame; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_SLOPE_X2) also doubles slope rate (writer unknown)

name: WOLF_FB_EQUIP_PENDING
meaning: equip selected item when wheel closes

name: WOLF_FB_RIVER_REGISTERED
meaning: set in 0x48b352 (FrozenRiver accepted); (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_SURFACED_NOTIFIED) msg 0x36 already sent at water surface

name: WOLF_FB_WOLFTRAP_REACT
meaning: MSG_STRUGGLE (0x40) sets it; WOLFTRAP_LOOP -> WOLFTRAP_REACT while set (section D, verified)

name: WOLF_FB_IN_WOLFTRAP
meaning: Wolf_DoAction 0x19 (CTX_WOLFTRAP) sets it; without it the wolftrap state exits; msg 0x33 clears (verified)

name: WOLF_FB_SPECIAL_OBJECT
meaning: +0x668 object in use; disables run; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_MOVE_LOOP_SOUND) no-run mode with loop sfx 0x11c while moving

name: WOLF_FB_ITEM_ACTION
meaning: DoAction 0x16 sets it; EnterState sends the +0x668 object msg 1 when leaving 0x20000 states (inferred)

name: WOLF_FB_INVISIBLE
meaning: msg 0x411

name: WOLF_FB_AXIS_LOCK_A
meaning: msg 0x44 arg 0, per frame

name: WOLF_FB_AXIS_LOCK_B
meaning: msg 0x44 arg 1, per frame

name: WOLF_FB_RESETTING
meaning: set during Wolf_Reset

name: WOLF_FB_PROMPT_DISABLED
meaning: msg 0x414

name: WOLF_FB_FORCE_FALL
meaning: msg 0x418, per frame; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_FALL_ANIM_4D) alt fall anim 0x4d / no air-run death

name: WOLF_FB_IN_SHADOW_ZONE
meaning: zone 0x6d0c88

name: WOLF_FB_IN_FOOTPRINT_ZONE
meaning: zone 0x6d0c78; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_STEP_SFX_78) alt footstep sfx 0x78 when DAT_006ddf6a==2

name: WOLF_FB_ON_MOVING_PLATFORM
meaning: 0x49205d returned motion

name: WOLF_FB_JUST_UNFROZEN
meaning: masks action edge this frame; (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_SUPPRESS_ACTION) set on control unlock; FilterInput removes action edge

name: WOLF_FB_NO_LOOK
meaning: msg 0x425, per frame

name: WOLF_FB_FROZEN_BUT_PROMPT
meaning: frozen, yet the action prompt stays allowed: set by WolfState 0x93 WOLF_ST_WOLFTRAP_START (Wolf::StateMachine flags |= 0x80000000) and cleared by Wolf::Unfreeze; Wolf::Update and msg 0 treat it as 'in control' while frozen (merged from WolfFlags718 WOLF_FL_LOCK_ALLOW_UPDATE: cleared on unlock; with 0x40 lets Wolf_Update proceed)
